answer: Each agent holds a nectar‑bond token that can be transferred only along a beacon‑validated edge whose capacity equals the minimum stake of its two endpoints; the network builds a max‑flow trust graph on a knoll of these edges, so any cluster of sybil nodes inherits a single bottleneck edge from a genuine node. When a fake cluster tries to earn rewards, the bottleneck caps total payout to the sum of the genuine node’s stake, preventing the cluster from draining more than that amount.
